description: Ingrid Lövgren leaves Friday. Please make sure her project docs move to me (jonas.ekholm@kestrelcloud.example) and not lost.
resolution: Followed the GWS offboarding runbook: on leaving date, suspended account, set mail auto-reply and delegation to manager for 30 days, ran Data transfer for Drive and Docs to the manager (files land in a folder named after the leaver), transferred Calendar events. Account to be deleted after 30 days.
comments: 2026-08-28 Collaboration Tools: Transfer done; manager confirmed access.

summary: Locked out of Mac after password change, needs FileVault key
description: Changed my password on the web and now my Mac's login window won't accept either password. Serial C02FN8PQML85.
resolution: Retrieved the individual FileVault recovery key from Jamf (Computer > Management > FileVault), read it to the user after identity verification by video call, user unlocked and set a new local password. Platform SSO then synced the password at next login. Key rotated automatically afterwards by the escrow profile.
comments: 2026-09-02 Service Desk: Identity verified by video with manager present. || 2026-09-02 Endpoint Engineering: Key viewed (audit logged). Rotation confirmed.

summary: Request new Google group for project
description: Need a group 'proj-falcon@kestrelcloud.example' for a project team of 8.
resolution: Created Google Group via Entra-synced security group 'GWS-proj-falcon' so membership is managed in Entra. Owners set to the requester and their manager. Default: internal-only posting.

summary: Google login error after rotation weekend
description: SAML error when opening Calendar. Cleared cookies already.
resolution: Certificate rotation in September followed the corrected procedure (new cert uploaded to Google before activation), but this user had a browser tab open with a stale SAML request. Closing all Google tabs and starting a fresh sign-in fixed it. No platform issue.
comments: 2026-09-14 Identity & Access: Checked SSO profile, cert valid and matching.

summary: Compliance fails on Defender after reinstall
description: Intune says Defender real-time protection off.
resolution: A third-party AV trial installed by the user had put Defender in passive mode. Uninstalled the trial, Defender returned to active mode, compliance green. Local admin rights for the user were removed per standard.

summary: Mac shows 'MDM enrollment: No' after logic board repair
description: Got my Mac back from repair; apps from Self Service won't install and VPN posture fails.
resolution: Logic board swap changed the hardware UUID, so Jamf saw a new device. Deleted the old record after confirming serial, re-ran Automated Device Enrolment with 'sudo profiles renew -type enrollment', confirmed PreStage assigned. Recon done; MeshGate posture passed.
comments: 2026-10-05 Endpoint Engineering: Two Jamf records for same serial. Old one removed.

summary: Laptop clock wrong, sign-in errors
description: Windows laptop clock is 7 minutes off, getting sign-in errors.
resolution: Windows Time service stopped after a failed update. Restarted w32time and resynced (w32tm /resync). Sign-in errors stopped. Intune remediation to keep w32time running is already in place; it ran after this fix.

summary: Can't reach internal wiki over MeshGate
description: Connected to MeshGate but wiki.kestrelcloud.example times out. My laptop IP 10.20.14.88.
resolution: Split DNS for *.kestrelcloud.example wasn't applied because the browser's DNS-over-HTTPS setting bypassed system DNS. Disabled browser 'secure DNS' (now enforced off by managed browser policy). Wiki resolves to internal IP.

summary: Unable to print from Austin office Mac
description: New Austin printer not available.
resolution: Austin queue was added to the Jamf print policy but the smart group used the old building name 'AUS-1'. Updated smart group to 'Austin', policy re-ran.
